class.name: JRPGStateData
class.brief_description: A state such as poison or sleep.
class.description: Database entry for a condition that changes a battler while it lasts: what it restricts, how it ends, its battle messages and its traits. State ID [constant KNOCKOUT_STATE_ID] is the knockout state, applied whenever HP reaches 0.

members.member: When the remaining turns are counted down: never, after the battler's action, or at the end of the turn.
Chance in percent to remove the state each time the battler takes damage.
Index of the state's icon in the project's icon sheet.
Battle message when a party member gets the state. [code]%1[/code] is the battler's name.
Battle message when an enemy gets the state.
Battle message while the state stays on.
Battle message when the state wears off.
Which state's icon is shown when a battler has several: the highest priority wins, then the lowest ID.
If [code]true[/code], the state is removed when the battle ends.
If [code]true[/code], taking damage can remove the state (see [member damage_removal_chance]).
If [code]true[/code], the state is removed when another state with a different restriction is added.
If [code]true[/code], the state is removed after the party walks [member steps_to_remove] steps on the map.
What the battler can still do while the state is on. When several states restrict a battler, the one furthest down the list wins.
Steps on the map that remove the state when [member remove_by_walking] is on.
Traits the battler has while the state is on.

constants.constant: The battler attacks an enemy on its own.
The battler attacks anyone on its own.
The battler attacks an ally on its own.
Turns are counted after the battler acts.
Turns are counted at the end of each turn.
